description: A suspend black horizontal stroke in the center of the paper. On the upper left end of the stroke is a black circle encompassing a smaller black circle. On the lower right end of the stroke is a black circle encompassing a smaller black circle. Surrounding both upper and lower circles are light black circles that end when they reach the black center stroke. There are eight  black dots above the center stroke and to the right of the circles. There are nine black dots below the center stroke and to the left of the circles.
